credentials_policy: anonymous public HTTP only; no search credential or GitHub token
network_policy: query public search and immutable raw metadata only; never clone, fetch, update, build dependencies, or mutate .lake
exploratory_query_boundary: No public-network discovery query was run before this protocol was frozen. A cited HTTP result must come from the bounded replay described here.
canonical_target: For every language L, index type I, family M of nonempty L-structures, ultrafilter U on I, and L-sentence phi, (U : Filter I).Product M models phi iff eventually i in U, M i models phi.
search_order: repository-local Lean sources outside the target-owned audit outputs
all locally materialized lake-manifest packages at their pinned revisions
pinned mathlib source, declaration body, and git lineage
official or primary public Lean 4 formalization repositories
other public Lean repositories through anonymous Sourcegraph and GitHub searches
immutable raw or tree metadata for any admitted external candidate
local_query_plan: exact declarations sentence_realize, realize_formula_cast, and boundedFormula_realize_cast
case-insensitive semantic terms ultraproduct, Los theorem, and sentence satisfaction
all materialized packages, followed by mathlib-specific source and history inspection
public_query_plan: Sourcegraph Lean exact short declaration sentence_realize with Ultraproduct
Sourcegraph Lean exact supporting declaration realize_formula_cast
Sourcegraph Lean quoted Los theorem phrase variants
GitHub repositories for Los theorem Lean4
GitHub repositories for ultraproduct Lean theorem prover
GitHub code for sentence_realize language Lean

selection_rules.exact: The candidate preserves arbitrary universes, language, index type, factor family, factor structures and nonemptiness, ultrafilter, universal sentence binder, and the satisfaction biconditional without adding assumptions.
selection_rules.supporting: Formula-with-assignment results, theory-preservation corollaries, principal-ultrafilter cases, and downstream uses require a checked specialization or composition and are not independent exact roots.
selection_rules.mismatch: A finite-index, principal-ultrafilter, fixed-language, one-way preservation, elementary-equivalence-only, or non-Lean-4 result is not the frozen root.
selection_rules.deduplication: Aliases, wrappers, generated declarations, downstream consumers, and supporting lemmas sharing the pinned terminal proof path count once.
selection_rules.proof_credit: A name, type, URL, search hit, inaccessible response, or upstream-only anchor never receives accepted M0 or theorem-completion credit.

negative_evidence_policy: Record the exact query, observation time, HTTP status, response SHA-256, parsed count/completion when available, and limitations. Access failures are limitations, never zero-result evidence.
